reason: Critical, but unreachable here. It needs the Magic Link plugin (not enabled) and a mounted Better Auth handler. Forms mounts no /api/auth route; src/lib/auth is unused template code (AuthProvider is an empty wrapper) and better-auth is absent from the deployed output. Studio login uses its own ps_studio session. Upgrading to 1.7 needs a rewrite of the unused Generic OAuth code and changes its callback path. Owner to choose: remove src/lib/auth and the dependency (recommended), or upgrade to 1.7.
